moves.label: Quick Clima-Tact Jab
moves.description: Fast high staff jab with a tiny active window for close checks.
moves.reason: Compact Clima-Tact poke at upper-body height.

moves.label: Clima-Tact Body Swipe
moves.description: Quick mid staff swipe with a short active window and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Red staff arc cuts through mid space.

moves.label: Clima-Tact Twin Twirl
moves.description: Slow mid twin twirl with a long active staff sequence and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Two-part staff twirl moves through mid range.

moves.label: Clima-Tact Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher with long active lift and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Upward staff motion is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Forecast Staff Kick
moves.description: Slow mid staff kick with a brief active window and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Delayed staff-assisted kick lands at mid height.

moves.label: Low Clima Sweep
moves.description: Slow low staff sweep with a moderate active window and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Low red arc sweeps across the opponent's legs.

moves.label: Weather Tempo Sweep
moves.description: Slow low knockdown sweep with extended active staff coverage.
moves.reason: Low spinning staff sweep is authored as a knockdown.

moves.label: Thunder Tempo Crush
moves.description: Fast mid knockdown crush with very long active weather-charge pressure.
moves.reason: Blue weather-charged rush is authored as a knockdown.

moves.label: Crouching Clima Guard
moves.description: Fast mid crouching guard twirl with long active staff coverage.
moves.reason: Crouched umbrella-like staff arc protects and strikes mid.

moves.label: Crouch Staff Launcher
moves.description: Steady mid launcher with a tiny active lift and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Crouch-to-staff swipe is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Overdrive Clima Jab
moves.description: Fast high overdrive jab with a long active staff check and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Overdrive command uses the high Clima-Tact jab.

moves.label: Mirage Tempo Drive
moves.description: Steady special knockdown drive with very long active staff pressure.
moves.reason: Sliding overdrive drive is authored as a special knockdown.

moves.label: While-Rising Staff Swipe
moves.description: Fast mid while-rising swipe with a brief active window and steady recovery.
moves.reason: While-rising command uses the mid staff swipe.

moves.label: Rising Gust Strike
moves.description: Slow mid rising strike with long active weather-charge coverage.
moves.reason: Rising yellow charge effect reads as a weather-powered strike.

moves.label: Ducking Clima Jab
moves.description: Fast high ducking jab with a long active staff check and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Down jab reuses the high Clima-Tact jab.

moves.label: Diagonal Staff Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher with a tiny active lift and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Diagonal staff swipe is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Forward Clima Guard
moves.description: Slow mid forward guard twirl with a tiny active hit and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Forward command uses the umbrella-like staff guard arc.

moves.label: Forward Staff Swipe
moves.description: Fast mid forward swipe with a brief active window and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Forward command uses the mid staff swipe.

moves.label: Clima Rush Jab
moves.description: Fast high rush jab with a long active staff check and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle jab keeps the high staff poke.

moves.label: Cyclone Tempo Burst
moves.description: Slow mid knockdown burst with long active spinning staff coverage.
moves.reason: Burst sequence spins the staff and is authored as a knockdown.
